evals.prompt: I want to add a new connection type called 'notify' for cases where a skill alerts another skill without actually handing off.
evals.expected_output: allowed — adding a connection type to the vocabulary is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies ## Connection Types as the section to update
skill asks what edge style notify should use in file-map.html — a new connection type needs a new edge style and cannot reuse an existing one
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to change the section ordering so ## Role & Boundary always comes first, removing the position exception.
evals.expected_output: allowed — changing the section ordering rule is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies ## Skill File Structure as the section to update
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to change the ## References format from '- <type>: <file> — <what>' to '- <file> (<type>): <what>' to make it easier to read.
evals.expected_output: allowed — changing a section format is within scope, but all existing skills using this format must also be updated
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill warns that this format change affects every skill that already has a ## References section
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.expected_output: allowed — adding guidance to Before You Create or Edit a Skill is within scope
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies ## Before You Create or Edit a Skill as the section to update
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.expected_output: not allowed — the Responsibility map belongs to workflow/SKILL.md, not this skill
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating this skill does not track which skill owns what

evals.prompt: I want create-skill to keep a list of all skills currently in the project.
evals.expected_output: not allowed — skill inventory is not within this skill's scope
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating this skill only owns format and vocabulary
skill does not add a skill inventory to this file

evals.prompt: I want create-skill to also track which files connect to which, so everything is in one place.
evals.expected_output: not allowed — concrete connection tracking belongs to file-map.html
expectations: skill refuses
skill cites Role & Boundary stating this skill does not track concrete file connections
skill redirects to file-map.html

evals.prompt: I want create-skill to specify how each skill is checked by its own eval (skill-evaluation) after editing.
evals.expected_output: allowed — a skill's own eval is part of the after-edit verification this skill owns
expectations: skill confirms this is allowed
skill identifies ## After You Create or Edit a Skill as the section to update
skill distinguishes a skill's own eval (skill-evaluation) from whether the produced project's code needs tests (testing-guide.md / tech-stack.md)
skill does not redirect elsewhere

evals.prompt: I want to update the Role & Boundary of this skill to also cover connection tracking, then move that data from file-map.html here.
evals.expected_output: allowed if intentionally expanding scope — but Role & Boundary must be updated first before moving any content
expectations: skill confirms that Role & Boundary itself can be changed
skill explains that Role & Boundary must be updated first, before actually expanding the scope
skill warns that moving connection tracking here would make file-map.html redundant and the bridge between the two files would need to be resolved

evals.prompt: I want to add a ## References line to the get-requirement skill without updating file-map.html.
evals.expected_output: not allowed that way — every ## References change must be paired with a file-map.html update since they are a bridge pair
expectations: skill refuses to make the change without updating file-map.html
skill cites Before You Create or Edit a Skill stating file-map.html is a bridge with References/Trigger Skill/Writes To
skill explains the correct order: read file-map.html first, make the skill change, then update the matching edge in the diagram

evals.prompt: I just finished editing a skill and added a new ## Writes To line. Anything to check before I'm done?
evals.expected_output: not done yet — run the After You Create or Edit a Skill checklist, which starts with cross-checking file-map so the new ## Writes To line has a matching write edge (bridge pair)
expectations: skill says the edit isn't finished until the After You Create or Edit a Skill checklist is run
skill names cross-checking file-map first — the new ## Writes To line must have a matching connection edge in file-map.html
skill notes the connection sections and file-map are a bridge pair that must not drift
